headline: Viatris (VTRS) Wins FDA Approval For Gwyn Lo Contraceptive Patch
summary: Viatris received U.S. FDA approval for its new combined hormonal contraceptive patch, Gwyn Lo. The product is a low dose estrogen contraceptive patch with data supporting efficacy and safety. This approval adds a fresh option to Viatris' women’s health portfolio and may influence its U.S. market position.
